name: ctxd
description: Keep source context current for agents with synchronization, path discovery and bounded reads

setup.notice: Configure ctxfs and synchronize a source before connecting. Use Linux with Python 3.11 or 3.12 and run the client as the same user.
steps: Select ctxfs, add a source folder, synchronize it and start the tracker using the README setup.
Connect and use tree to find a source path, then read that path.
